svg.title: K13 · Security hardened the network. Now nothing can find anything.: the setup
svg.desc: The cast of scenario 13: visitor (asks every 2 s,, prints a result); Service showdown (one stable address); Pod showdown (Cats vs Dogs); Pod redis (the database). Also: NetworkPolicy ("lockdown", only talk to Redis). Your mission: Why can the app not find Redis after the lockdown?

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: K13 · Security hardened the network. Now nothing can find anything.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Security locked the app down so it can only talk to Redis. And now the app cannot even find Redis.
